scripts.docker:reset-seeder: docker-compose -f infra/compose/docker-compose.dev.yml rm -sf db-seeder && docker-compose -f infra/compose/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d db-seeder
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm run --filter '@gym-coach/auth-service' db:migrate && pnpm run --filter '@gym-coach/user-service' db:migrate && pnpm run --filter '@gym-coach/fitness-service' db:migrate && pnpm run --filter '@gym-coach/ai-service' db:migrate && pnpm run --filter '@gym-coach/chat-service' db:migrate && pnpm run --filter '@gym-coach/gym-service' db:migrate && pnpm run --filter '@gym-coach/payment-service' db:migrate
scripts.db:seed: pnpm run --filter '@gym-coach/auth-service' db:seed && pnpm run --filter '@gym-coach/user-service' db:seed && pnpm run --filter '@gym-coach/fitness-service' db:seed
scripts.seed:cleanup: docker exec -e POSTGRES_HOST=postgres -e POSTGRES_PORT=5432 -e POSTGRES_USER=gymcoach -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=gymcoach_password gymcoach-auth-dev sh -c 'cd /app && node scripts/cleanup-test-users.mjs'
scripts.prisma:generate: pnpm --filter @gym-coach/auth-service run db:generate && pnpm --filter @gym-coach/user-service run db:generate && pnpm --filter @gym-coach/fitness-service run db:generate && pnpm --filter @gym-coach/ai-service run db:generate && pnpm --filter @gym-coach/chat-service run db:generate && pnpm --filter @gym-coach/gym-service run db:generate && pnpm --filter @gym-coach/payment-service run db:generate
